# Save.ps1 - the server saves one of its own files back to the engine repo, so a change made on the
# server (through the console) becomes the repo's copy too and the next pull does not undo it.
#   pwsh -File server/Save.ps1 Engine.ps1            (path relative to the working folder)
param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path, [string]$Dir = "/home/lhc/fantasy", [string]$Repo = "scfinney03-del/lethimcook-engine", [string]$Branch = "main")
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$src = Join-Path $Dir $Path; if (-not (Test-Path $src)) { throw "no such file: $src" }
$gh = Get-Content (Join-Path $Dir "github.json") -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$hdr = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $($gh.token)"; Accept = "application/vnd.github+json"; "User-Agent" = "LetHimCook-Server" }
$api = "https://api.github.com/repos/$Repo/contents/" + ($Path -replace "\\", "/")
$sha = $null; try { $sha = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($api + "?ref=$Branch") -Headers $hdr -TimeoutSec 20).sha } catch {}
$body = @{ message = "server: $Path " + (Get-Date -Format "ddd h:mm tt"); content = [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($src)); branch = $Branch }; if ($sha) { $body.sha = $sha }
$r = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put -Uri $api -Headers $hdr -ContentType "application/json" -Body ($body | ConvertTo-Json) -TimeoutSec 60
# bring the repo clone up to date so the next pull sees no difference and copies nothing back
try { & git -C "/home/lhc/engine" pull -q --ff-only 2>&1 | Out-Null } catch {}
"saved $Path -> $Repo ($($r.commit.sha.Substring(0,7)))"
=====
# Pull.ps1 - the server's side of the hand-off. Cron runs it every minute.
# 1. git pull the engine repo (deploy key, read-only)  2. copy changed files into the working folder
# 3. unseal secrets when the bundle changed  4. unpack the state snapshot once  5. apply server/control.txt
param([string]$Repo = "/home/lhc/engine", [string]$Dir = "/home/lhc/fantasy")
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
$log = Join-Path $Dir "pull_log.txt"
function Log($m) { Add-Content $log ("{0}  {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format "ddd HH:mm:ss"), $m) }
trap { Log ("  ERROR at line " + $_.InvocationInfo.ScriptLineNumber + ": " + $_.Exception.Message); continue }
# one pull at a time: a lock folder, treated as stale after 15 minutes
$lock = Join-Path $Dir ".pull_lock"
if (Test-Path $lock) { if ((New-TimeSpan -Start (Get-Item -Force $lock).LastWriteTime -End (Get-Date)).TotalMinutes -lt 15) { exit 0 } else { Remove-Item $lock -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $lock -Force | Out-Null
try {
$pass = (Get-Content "/home/lhc/.deploy_pass" -Raw).Trim()
Push-Location $Repo
$before = (& git rev-parse HEAD 2>$null); & git pull -q --ff-only 2>&1 | Out-Null; $after = (& git rev-parse HEAD 2>$null)
Pop-Location
$first = -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Dir "Engine.ps1"))
# report home every few minutes whether or not anything changed
$stS = Join-Path $Repo "server/Status.ps1"; $stMark = Join-Path $Dir ".status_sent"
$stDue = (-not (Test-Path $stMark)) -or ((New-TimeSpan -Start (Get-Item -Force $stMark).LastWriteTime -End (Get-Date)).TotalMinutes -ge 4.5)
if ($stDue -and (Test-Path $stS)) { try { & pwsh -NoProfile -File $stS -Dir $Dir } catch {} }
if ($before -eq $after -and -not $first) { exit 0 }
